Used Service Locator pattern for lookup of the beans. Used Command Design pattern to execute the sequence of events. Designed and Implemented Data Access Objects to store the message into the DB. Used VO pattern that is populated from message and stores in db. Used Java Mailing Service APIs for mailing the alerts in message processing based on message dat Used Factory pattern that creates DAO objects.
